info.name: Delphi API Starter Kit
info.description: Auth-v2 current source contract. Default development port 9000; require HTTPS in deployment. Fresh SQL has no login credential; provision offline. Set private runtime inputs; never save issued credentials or passwords in this collection. See docs/api/auth.md and wave-01-result.md for evidence/gates.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Auth-v2. Run individual lifecycle requests with an isolated user. Login/Refresh store issued credentials in local pm.variables only; collection/environment saved values stay blank. Logout/reuse/password mutations invalidate credentials. No public registration or email recovery.

request.description: Consumed token replay revokes family. Lost response requires login.

item.name: Users
item.description: Admin-managed auth-v2. role_id input stays numeric; public Role URL is UUID. Initial password restricted; setup/reset tokens shown once. DELETE/status/role/password/grants revoke credentials. Administrative self mutation denied.

request.description: Replace quoted placeholder with a JSON integer; role_id:null unassigns. String/coercion is rejected.
